name: Offline PCAP Packet Visualizer & Protocol Analyzer
desc: Inspect, parse, and analyze libpcap capture files locally in browser memory. Dissect Ethernet, VLAN, IPv4, IPv6, TCP, UDP, ICMP, and ARP frames with zero data upload.

name: PE & ELF Binary Header Viewer
desc: Inspect Portable Executable (PE .exe, .dll) and ELF binary headers, sections, entry points, and architectures locally in your browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.

name: Windows Registry Hive Viewer
desc: Inspect, parse, and analyze Windows Registry hives (NTUSER.DAT, SYSTEM, SOFTWARE, SAM) and .reg files locally in your browser. 100% client-side memory execution, zero tracking, zero network egress.

name: Offline SQLite Database Viewer & Inspector
desc: Open, query, and inspect SQLite (.db, .sqlite, .sqlite3) databases directly in your browser. Zero uploads, zero tracking, entirely client-side.

name: Binary Strings Extractor
desc: Extract printable ASCII and Unicode (UTF-16LE dual-pass) strings from binaries, executables, malware samples, and firmware directly in your browser. Zero tracking, zero network egress.

name: Offline SVG Sanitizer & XSS Defanger
desc: Sanitize SVG vectors, strip inline scripts, event handlers, foreignObject injection, and external entity exploits locally in memory. Zero network egress.

name: Wasm Disassembler & Bytecode Inspector
desc: Inspect, parse sections, disassemble bytecodes, and audit WebAssembly binaries (.wasm) locally in your browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.
